stateNote: In a pot, boil water with little salt and a dash of turmeric. When the water is boiling, flatten the stuffed Kibbeh balls into the shape of a flat full moon the size of a little plate. Put each kibbeh gently down into the boiling water, and boil it until it floats. Floating is a sign of the kibbeh being cooked through and ready to eat.

issues.note: no temperature given; used the middle of boil's typical range
